chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 20, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.UNCLE1: UNCLE1: a Moroccan man in his fifties with a grey moustache, wearing a brown wool djellaba with the hood down
chars.UNCLE2: UNCLE2: a thin bald Moroccan man in his forties with a short black beard, wearing a navy tracksuit with white side stripes
chars.GRANDPA: GRANDPA: a very old Moroccan man with a long white beard, wearing a cream wool djellaba and a white turban

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside the dark room of an old ochre stone rural house near Agadir, lit by one oil lantern on the floor. UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 kneel by a freshly dug hole in the earth floor, UNCLE2 lifting a dusty old clay pot out of the hole, both caught mid-act, looking up startled toward the doorway. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, lantern light, close shot inside the hole in the earth floor: an old cracked clay pot spilling ancient gold and silver coins, the hands and excited faces of UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 above it, eyes wide, greedy smiles. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, in the doorway of the old ochre stone house near Agadir. UNCLE1 holds a finger to his lips saying 'shh' while UNCLE2 covers the hole with flattened cardboard boxes, both glancing around nervously. Head-to-waist framing, faces visible. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Daytime family lunch in a Moroccan village house near Agadir: relatives (other brothers and sisters, out of focus) eat couscous around a low round table, while in the foreground UNCLE1 and UNCLE2 sit apart and whisper to each other with sly guilty faces. Medium shot, the two uncles' faces clearly visible. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small modest bedroom in a small Moroccan town. NARRATOR sits on his bed holding his phone, reading a message, frowning skeptically with one eyebrow raised. Head-to-waist shot, face clearly visible, phone screen glowing. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Warm evening flashback inside a simple village house near Agadir: GRANDPA sits on a cushion telling a story with a raised finger, while two small children sit in front of him listening with wide eyes. Soft warm sepia light, GRANDPA's face clearly visible. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Old-times night flashback in a Moroccan rural douar near Agadir: an ancestor man in an old brown djellaba buries a small wooden chest in the earth floor of an ochre stone house by candle light, looking over his shoulder. Sepia tones, his face visible. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, small modest bedroom in a small Moroccan town with peeling paint and an old mattress. NARRATOR stands by the window with his phone in his hand, eyes wide, realization on his face, thinking hard, the moon outside. Head-to-waist shot, face clearly visible. Subjects centered in the frame, calm background at the edges, no text anywhere in the image, 2D animated illustration style.
